2016.change_reason: First available year with text, so no prior comparison is possible.
2016.analyst_notes: The chosen URL is the bankofamerica.com homepage, which is a sign-in and product page with no mission or values language. Content is product promotion, privacy and security tips, and sign-in boilerplate, so it is not a mission page.

2017.change_reason: Promotional rotation changed (student checking, Zelle and identity-theft tips replace the cash-rewards card), but the page is still a sign-in and promotions homepage with no values language, so the change is in promotions only.
2017.analyst_notes: Homepage fallback with transactional, promotional copy rather than a mission statement. The tone is helpful but product-centric.

2018.change_reason: The page gains its first purpose statement and a new homepage layout: 'Our purpose is to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.'
2018.analyst_notes: The purpose line is the first genuine values language in the BAC series; the rest is product and digital promotion (Erica, digital mortgage). Tone is warm and customer-oriented.

2019.change_reason: The purpose statement is dropped; the page now centers on Better Money Habits, the digital mortgage experience and the mobile app.
2019.analyst_notes: No values language; emphasis moves to product and digital tools. Mostly homepage navigation and promotions.

2020.change_reason: Pandemic-era reassurance replaces product promotion: 'We're here to help with what's next' and a new Life Services block.
2020.analyst_notes: Supportive, reassuring tone. Still no explicit mission or values statement; reads as homepage messaging.

2021.change_reason: The headline shifts to 'Financial guidance to help with navigating the new normal', and a Life Plan goal-tracking tool becomes the featured module.
2021.analyst_notes: Guidance-oriented, pandemic-recovery framing with specific product promotion (Life Plan). Still no values statement.

2022.change_reason: Only the headline changes (to 'Financial guidance for every stage of life'); the Better Money Habits and Life Plan modules are identical. The framing is less crisis-specific, but this is a minor framing shift rather than a substantive change.
2022.analyst_notes: Same modules as 2021 under a lifecycle headline; generic and promotional, with no explicit values language.

2023.change_reason: Security replaces Life Plan as the featured module ('Level up your account security', with a security meter), and the Life Plan module is dropped.
2023.analyst_notes: Security and fraud protection is now the lead message, framed as customer protection and trust. It is a product feature rather than a stated value.

2024.change_reason: The headline changes to 'Your financial goals matter' and adds the first community language ('financial education and programs that make communities stronger'); the security module is retained.
2024.analyst_notes: This is the first community-oriented wording in the BAC series, but it is a single sentence. Security remains the main module.
